column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rules (zap-baseline.py -c). Every rule fails the build except the reviewed ones below
# (IGNORE: not applicable to the scan; WARN: accepted, still reported).
# Regenerate the list with -g and keep these decisions.

column3: (Cookie Without Secure Flag) -- Secure cookies are set over HTTPS (the scan runs over plain HTTP on localhost)
(Information Disclosure - Sensitive Information in HTTP Referrer Header)
(Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments) -- matches words like "user" in minified library code
(Strict-Transport-Security Header) -- HSTS is sent over HTTPS (the scan runs over plain HTTP on localhost)
(Server Leaks Information via "X-Powered-By" HTTP Response Header Field(s))
(HTTP to HTTPS Insecure Transition in Form Post)
(HTTPS to HTTP Insecure Transition in Form Post)
(Storable and Cacheable Content) -- informational: the API is no-store by design; hashed assets cache for a year
(CSP) -- CSP: style-src 'unsafe-inline' is needed for React style attributes and the styles Monaco injects; inline CSS can't run script
(Modern Web Application) -- informational: the scan uses the AJAX spider (-j) for the single-page app
(Cross-Origin Policies) -- CORP and COOP are set; COEP isn't, as require-corp would block the PDF and editor workers
